org: HL CRM (mcdynccatdev01/HousingLoan, test) — production URL TO_CONFIRM
notes: Per-org survey configuration for HL CRM (individual customers = contacts). Same shape as provisioning/seed/*.json. Every value marked TO_CONFIRM has an entry in `questions`; a row carrying TO_CONFIRM must not be entered until it is answered. Enter the rows in the Survey Engine app (Configuration area) after the kit is imported. Sources are created INACTIVE; a System Administrator activates each one with qdb_srv_ActivateSource once its trigger values are known.

questions.question: Which HL CRM tables are the survey sources, and which field on each holds the customer (a lookup to contact)? HL is the housing-loan CRM; it may have no Fund Transfer table, in which case delete that row.
questions.evidence: The cloud sandbox mirrors BFD, not HL (Debt Collection, 2026-10-05); no HL request table is known.

questions.question: On each HL source, which field tells a Digital (portal) request from a Legacy (customer-service) one, and which value(s) mean Digital?
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(d). On the cloud org the Disbursements and Fund Transfer origin field is qdb_source_location, 751090002 = QDB Digital.

questions.question: For each survey to send, which statuscode value(s) fire it, and for which request types? These go on the trigger rows the survey administrator creates; the activation API checks them against the table's metadata.
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(b). Status values are per org.
questions.owner: QDB business owner + HL CRM administrator

questions.question: Default survey language for HL customers: en or ar?
questions.evidence: Cloud uses en. Used when the customer has no language value.

questions.question: Which contact field holds the customer's preferred language (text en/ar or a choice)? Empty is a valid answer: everyone then gets the default language.
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(c). Debt Collection found no existing preferred-language field on contact; it proposed qdb_collectionlanguage, which is not built.

questions.question: Which contact field holds the customer's mobile number for SMS?
questions.evidence: Debt Collection Customer 360 map: HL mobile = contact.mobilephone, 'or QDB field — TBD'. HL cases copy qdb_customer_mobile_number from the customer (Case Management findings).

questions.question: HL sends SMS and WhatsApp through Letter, told apart by vrp_type. Which vrp_type value means SMS? Are any other columns required for the SMS service to pick a row up (subject, owner, status)?
questions.evidence: Debt Collection configuration guide 2a: vrp_type is the channel marker on HL Letter; its values are not in the schema evidence.
questions.owner: QDB HL CRM administrator / SMS service owner

questions.question: Does the SMS service need the customer on the Letter's To party? The engine links the customer through Regarding (regardingobjectid → contact) and puts the number in vrp_address; it cannot fill the To party without a code change.
questions.evidence: Debt Collection links the customer through the To party. Whether the SMS service reads To is unknown.

questions.question: Confirm the Letter text column is vrp_description (logical name) on HL.
questions.evidence: Confirmed on HL 2026-10-06 (schema name vrp_Description, Debt Collection configuration guide); the cloud sandbox spells it vrp_descriptions.

questions.question: Which queue sends survey emails on HL? It needs an approved, enabled mailbox (Email Router or server-side sync).
questions.evidence: Readiness F9; on cloud a queue without an address failed every send.

questions.question: The customer-portal URL of the survey link page for HL customers (the token is appended as ?token=…).
questions.evidence: OQ-A2(f); integration guide, secure-link flow. Secure links stay off until the security review (NFR-CSE-009).

questions.question: How long survey responses are kept, and whether they are then deleted or anonymised.
questions.evidence: OQ-A1, QDB Compliance. Empty = no retention pass runs.
